mohan: quick sync - i'm proposing an adaptive-drain + lease-extension handoff for continuous batching. main idea: instead of immediate queue drain when a deadline hits, we attempt a short lease extension (few ms) to let an in-flight microbatch finish packing. reduces dropped opportunities but has queueing tradeoffs.

rachel: can you sketch the decision boundary? when do we extend vs force-drain?

mohan: heuristics: extend when (a) remaining headroom > minimal_pack_threshold AND (b) estimated pack-win probability > 0.6. otherwise drain. estimated pack-win uses tokens_per_req and recent arrival rate.

diego: risk is tail latency for higher-priority tenants behind the extension. how do we bounded that?

mohan: we limit extension to X ms (configurable), and charge extension credits to the tenant (reduces future admission priority). also expose a preempt flag: high-priority requests can preempt an extension by flipping preempt=true.

anya: how does this interact with KV cache warmups and probe paths? if we extend and the new requests are probes (no-kv), we wasted packing opportunity.

mohan: we tag extension candidates and prefer full-admission requests for extension. probes are deprioritized for extension eligibility. also, if an extended batch includes a promote flag, we trigger lightweight prefetch as part of the extension window.

rachel: config snippet plz

mohan: sure:

```
queue.drain_extension.enabled = true
queue.drain_extension.max_ms = 12
queue.drain_extension.min_pack_headroom = 64
queue.drain_extension.win_prob_threshold = 0.6
queue.drain_extension.tenant_credit_cost = 1
queue.drain_extension.preemptible = true
```

diego: metrics we need: extension_attempts, extension_success_rate, extension_blocked_by_preempt, p99_delta_by_priority. also tenant_credit_balance gauge.

anya: ops playbook: if pool-wide p99 increases after enabling, steps: 1) reduce max_ms to 0 (disable extension), 2) limit to a subset of tenants by packing score, 3) roll back. add alert for extension_success_rate < 20% (means we're extending but not getting packs).

mohan: action items: (1) prototype flag + metric hooks (owner: mohan) (2) dashboard and alert (owner: diego) (3) add preempt header semantics to admission API (owner: anya) (4) run 24h canary with 10% traffic (owner: rachel).

sre-bot: note: scheduled canary window 2026-04-03T01:00:00Z for 24h. monitor /eng-runtime/telemetry/extension.

rachel: let's also capture trace samples of preempted vs extended batches (1% each) so we can analyze packing outcomes.

mohan: good call. i'll include simplified logs: extension_start, extension_end, extension_result (packed/timeout/preempted).

diego: one more thought: long-term, this might be folded into admission contracts (tokens and credits refactor). mark as candidate for scheduler-refactor epic.

mohan: noted. will add to backlog with RFC stub. thanks all.
